title: Discordling Dark Animist
summary: The dark animist opens with five beasts and a recurring spell rotation.
overview: The dark animist opens with five beasts and a recurring spell rotation.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Collect the five afflicted beasts immediately when the boss appears.
Prepare for Discordant Feedback and Corporeal Torment while controlling the animals.
Complete the fight within the thirty-minute combat window.
